simulation_only_disclaimer: All Phase 17 tests are simulation-side assessments only and do NOT constitute physical hardware safety or real-world deployment proof.

milestones.name: Cross-Simulator Policy Validation (PyBullet -> MuJoCo 4.0.1)
milestones.notes: Built MJCF Franka Panda PickPlace twin; evaluated frozen PyBullet policies with zero retraining (sac_dr4_seed42: 40% bilateral contact, 5% grasp, 0% full success) and calibrated MuJoCo contact/friction physics (50% bilateral contact, 15% grasp, 5% full success); classified mismatches in observation Z offset and actuator/contact dynamics.

milestones.name: Sim-to-Real Readiness Assessment (Simulation-Side)
milestones.notes: 7-condition stress test + SafetySupervisor E-stop check (32.41 us check latency, 250 post-trip commands blocked): 100% under 5mm noise, frequency jitter & low friction/heavy mass; 90% under 1-step latency; 60% under RGB-D +-8mm calib bias; 20% under 2-step latency.

milestones.name: Optional Hardware Integration Preparation
milestones.notes: ROS 2 topic/service contracts, FrankaState/CartesianDeltaCommand abstractions, SafetySupervisor, and StubLiveFrankaDriver designed and unit-tested; live physical hardware execution NOT_ATTEMPTED (no physical robot).
